Koji (Japanese: ユウジ Yūji) is a character of the day who appeared in Good 'Quil Hunting.

He was a brash young who wanted a , and ended up competing with to one in a forest. Even though Ash caught one first, Koji pressured Ash into a , with the prize being the Ash already caught. Against 's better judgment, Ash accepted the challenge and had Cyndaquil battle Koji's . During the battle, Koji was shown to be a confident Trainer with a powerful Pokémon. He is not a kind Trainer, and pressured his Sandslash to continue the battle even though it was exhausted.

Despite having a disadvantage, Cyndaquil was able to use its speed and attack to defeat the Sandslash has lost a lot of stamina. Koji then decided to try to steal Cyndaquil anyway in a net, only to get badly burned when it used a at him, causing him to run away. As he fled, Brock yelled after him that he should train himself before any more Pokémon.

==Trivia==
Koji shares a few similarities with Damian and Shamus, as the three of them are brash and have tried to claim first partner Pokémon as their own, ending in rejection by said Pokémon's .
The major difference between Koji and the other two is that Damian and Shamus actually owned Fire first partner Pokémon ( and , respectively), while Koji never actually owned Cyndaquil at any point.
